verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's API supports pulling data for dashboards/warehouses (docs-18) and creating campaigns (docs-7), with authenticated API access and SDKs, but there's no specific evidence of dedicated campaign/flow performance metrics endpoints (e.g., open rate, click rate, revenue attribution per flow) being documented in this pack. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of campaign/flow analytics/metrics API endpoints, evidence of reporting API schema, and independent developer corroboration of pulling performance data into a warehouse.
